create_QHAdam_optimizer: create a QHAdam optimizer for model parameters with custom learning rate, betas, and nus hyperparameters
run_QHAdam_step: run a single optimization step with the QHAdam optimizer after computing gradients
create_QHAdamW_optimizer: create a QHAdamW optimizer with decoupled weight decay for model parameters
review_QHAdam_from_nadam: review the QHAdam from_nadam class method to get hyperparameters that recover NAdam behavior
test_QHAdam_weight_decay: test the QHAdam optimizer with coupled or decoupled weight decay on model parameters
